user.title: Connect to Greenbone
user.description: Enter the connection details for the GMP TCP relay on your Greenbone scanner host (not the web UI port - see the integration's README for setting up the relay).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Greenbone. Check the host, port, credentials, and that the GMP relay is running and reachable from Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Greenbone instance is already configured.
